To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the synthesis and structure-activity relationship of a series of caffeic acid analogs, bearing a 1,2,3-triazole moiety at the C-3 position, have been studied in detail.
the triazole-containing caffeate analogues 13d, 15 and 15a are potent and selective inhibitors of 5-LO with IC50 of <1 μm in a cell-based assay.
a novel series of caffeic acid analogs containing a triazole ring was developed, and that the most active compounds were found to be 13d, 15 and 15.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis, SAR and biological evaluation of novel triazole-containing caffeate analogues as 50-LO inhibitors.
the development of a novel series with potent 5-LO inhibitory activity and with a good selectivity profile.
the development of a novel series triazole-containing caffeate analogues that may be used as 5-LO inhibitors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the compounds described here are a new class of 5-LO inhibitors that may serve as lead compounds for the development of novel anti-asthmatic drugs.
the compounds reported herein represent a new class of potent inhibitors of 5-LO that are worthy of further development.
the triazole-containing caffeate derivatives 15 and 18 are the most active 5-LO inhibitors among all the synthesized compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SAR studies performed led to the identification of novel triazole-containing caffeates with improved biological activity.
the triazole moiety was successfully introduced into the caffeic acid scaffold to improve the activity of the parent compound caffeic acid and to provide a novel series of potent 5-LO inhibitors.
the SAR studies of caffeic acid and zileuton analogues resulted in compounds with excellent 5-Lo inhibition and selectivity over COX and 12-LO.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the triazole-containing caffeoyl moiety is a good scaffold for the design of 5-LO inhibitors.
the introduction of a triazole ring in caffeic acid 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone 4 and caffeic acid 1,2-dinitrophenyldiazomethane 5 led to compounds with improved activity and selectivity.
the triazole ring is a useful scaffold for designing new 5-LO inhibitors.
